**Context.** LIDAR Lab, Georgia Tech, with Prof. Ye Zhao. Aug 2025 – present.

**Problem.** Post-training a vision-language-action policy with RL needs a reward signal
that is dense, cheap, and trustworthy on real-robot video. Large VLMs can judge progress
but are too slow to query every step and are not calibrated for the task.

**What I built.**
- LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on LIBERO-Spatial for sub-task segmentation and
  success/failure classification (QwenLM `qwen-vl-finetune`, Georgia Tech PACE A40/H100).
- A four-step chain-of-thought reward-labeling scheme on Qwen2.5-VL
  (criteria → description → analysis → rating) for consistent progress scores.
- A reward-distillation path from VLM labels into lightweight reward models that run in the
  control loop, plus a robot reward-dataset pipeline built on RBM-1M / Robometer.

**Ongoing.** *coffee-agent*: a self-evolving agent that improves a pour-over coffee routine on
a real robot, using the reward/critic model to guide updates during out-of-distribution
exploration.
